verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents vendor bill pay: paying vendors in bulk, managing vendor payment details, scheduling payments that can arrive the same day, and "no transfer fees or wire fees." However, its payment messaging is almost entirely about cross-border, FX and stablecoin rails, and no item explicitly confirms domestic US ACH or domestic wire as payment methods. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of domestic ACH rails, explicit domestic wire support, independent or hands-on corroboration of domestic vendor payments.
